title: Ventspils — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Ventspils: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Ventspils has a population of 34,377. Latvia’s most important ice-free port, a well-planned city with a beautiful blue flag beach, the Ventspils Castle of the Livonian Order, and a high quality of life. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Sunshine is limited, with about 57 sunny days a year.
